statement.name: GetMessages
statement.sql: * from ( Select pmm.MessageId , pmm.Type AS MessageTypeCode , pmm.Message AS Message , pmm.StartDate AS StartDate , pmm.EndDate AS EndDate , pmm.UserTypeCode AS UserTypeCode , Cast(Convert(varchar(10),pmm.StartDate,101) as DATETIME) AS StartDateFilter , Cast(Convert(varchar(10),pmm.EndDate,101) as DATETIME) AS EndDateFilter , (replace(convert(varchar(8), pmm.StartDate, 10), '-', '/') + ' ' + substring(convert(varchar(20), pmm.StartDate, 9), 13, 5) + ' ' + substring(convert(varchar(30), pmm.StartDate, 9), 25, 2)) AS MessageStartDateDisplay , (replace(convert(varchar(8), pmm.EndDate, 10), '-', '/') + ' ' + substring(convert(varchar(20), pmm.EndDate, 9), 13, 5) + ' ' + substring(convert(varchar(30), pmm.EndDate, 9), 25, 2)) AS MessageEndDateDisplay , CASE WHEN lut.LongDisplayValue IS NULL THEN 'All' ELSE lut.LongDisplayValue END AS UserType , lpmt.Description AS MessageType , CASE WHEN getdate() BETWEEN pmm.StartDate AND isnull(pmm.EndDate, pmm.StartDate) THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS IsCurrentlyActive FROM dbo.PFM_MSGS_Messages pmm LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.LookupUserType lut ON lut.LookupCode = pmm.UserTypeCode LEFT OUTER JOIN dbo.LU_PFM_MSGS_Type lpmt ON lpmt.LookupCode = pmm.Type ) AS FinalData

statement.name: ValidateSystemMessage
statement.sql:
Select count(*) FROM PFM_MSGS_Messages WHERE ( Between StartDate And EndDate OR Between StartDate And EndDate OR StartDate Between AND OR EndDate Between AND ) AND
( UserTypeCode = OR UserTypeCode IS NULL ) AND
Type = AND MessageId !=

statement.name: GetUserTypes
statement.sql: SELECT convert(varchar(MAX),LookupCode) as LookupCode, LongDisplayValue as DisplayValue FROM LookupUserType ORDER BY LookupCode

statement.name: GetMessageTypes
statement.sql: SELECT convert(varchar(MAX),LookupCode) as LookupCode, Description as DisplayValue FROM dbo.LU_PFM_MSGS_Type ORDER BY LookupCode
